investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Northwave Finance (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.195.0.0/16; Edge tier: api-gateway (Envoy) on dedicated instances; gateway configuration is distributed from a config repository by a sync service; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
